_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We purchase, transport, store and distribute natural gas.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'Our nonregulated businesses have a higher level of risk than our regulated businesses.' (the FY2006 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule)

classification.quality_note: 'We purchase, transport, store and distribute natural gas.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'Our nonregulated businesses have a higher level of risk than our regulated businesses.' (the FY2006 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.39x; +51% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.84; conservative 2yr -13%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.1%/yr (worst year FY02-FY06, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.0%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.0-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.5%/yr (FY02-FY06 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY06, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2008-01-04) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.39x (45.9% downside to Bear $24 / +33.1% upside to Bull $59) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 2.99: gap -0.84 [OVERVALUED] | +51% above the EPP floor $29 (11x FY07E $2.67) | Conservative 2-yr case: -13.4% total (-6.7%/yr) | At 16.6x FY07E the 15% hurdle price $59 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net margin -2.7% and Distribution operating income +82.6% in Q3 2007, forward revenues +6.2% (no FY07 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2007 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a gas distributor and midstream company on this date; none has dated evidence.
